stories.title: 1.22 million died from tuberculosis in 2023:Gorakhpur AIIMS global analysis published in 'The Lancet Infectious Diseases'
stories.summary: Tuberculosis (TB) continues to be the world's deadliest infectious disease. In 2023, around 9.11 million new TB cases were reported globally, while approximately 1.22 million people died from the disease. The findings were shared by Dr U. Venkatesh, Associate Professor in the Department of Community and Family Medicine at Gorakhpur AIIMS, and Dr Arup Mohanty, Media In-charge, based on a meta-analysis of a global study published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases. Study analysed data from 204 countries over three decades The doctors said the original study was led by the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) at the University of Washington. Researchers analysed TB-related data from 204 countries and territories covering the period from 1990 to 2023. The study was published in The Lancet Infectious Diseases on July 1, 2026. HIV-related and drug-resistant TB remain major challenges According to the meta-analysis, around 781,000 new TB cases were reported among people living with HIV in 2023, while approximately 210,000 people died from HIV-associated TB. The study also identified around 466,000 new cases of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis (MDR-TB), with approximately 102,000 deaths attributed to the drug-resistant form of the disease. TB cases and deaths have declined, but drug-resistant TB remains a concern Dr U. Venkatesh and Dr Arup Mohanty said that between 2015 and 2023, the number of new TB cases fell by around 19%, while TB-related deaths declined by 23%. However, they noted that progress in controlling multidrug-resistant TB remains slow, making it a continuing global public health concern. According to the study, South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa continue to bear the highest burden of tuberculosis. The researchers identified smoking, alcohol consumption and poorly controlled diabetes as the major risk factors for developing the disease. They said that effective control of these risk factors, along with early diagnosis and timely treatment, could save a significant number of lives. Funding cuts could jeopardise WHO's 2035 TB elimination target The doctors warned that declining global financial support for TB control programmes is a serious concern for future efforts to eliminate the disease. They stressed that diagnosis, treatment and prevention strategies must be further strengthened. Without sustained action, achieving the World Health Organization's (WHO) target of eliminating TB by 2035 could become increasingly difficult. Key TB statistics

stories.title: ₹10 lakh travel insurance for just 45 paise:Accident cover available with train, flight, bus and cab bookings
stories.summary: When booking a train ticket through the IRCTC website or mobile app, passengers are shown a small checkbox before proceeding to payment asking whether they want travel insurance worth ₹10 lakh for just 45 paise. Many passengers select the option without a second thought because ₹10 lakh of cover for 45 paise appears to be an excellent deal. However, simply ticking ‘Yes’ while booking the ticket does not guarantee that your family will receive the insurance benefit. Under the current rules, it is mandatory to provide the nominee's name along with the details of a government-issued identity document. If these details are not updated, the insurance claim may not be settled smoothly. Travel insurance and accident cover are now also offered while booking flights, buses and app-based taxi services such as Ola, Uber and Rapido. Here's what you need to know. 90% of passengers make mistakes while booking train tickets The ₹10 lakh travel insurance is available only to passengers who select the "Travel Insurance" option while booking tickets online through the IRCTC website or mobile app. It is not available on tickets purchased from railway booking counters. Once the insurance option is selected, the insurance company sends a policy number and a link to the passenger's registered mobile number and email address. Using this link, passengers must enter the nominee's name, age and relationship. If the link cannot be found, nominee details can also be updated through the "Booked Ticket History" section on the IRCTC website or app. If an accident occurs during the journey and nominee details have not been updated, the insurance company does not automatically release the claim. Instead, the legal heirs may have to obtain a Succession Certificate through the courts before the claim can be processed. It is also important to note that the immediate financial assistance of ₹5 lakh or ₹10 lakh announced by the Railway Minister or the government after major train accidents is an ex gratia payment. This is entirely separate from travel insurance and statutory compensation. Flight bookings offer personal accident cover of up to ₹50 lakh Passengers booking domestic flights through MakeMyTrip, EaseMyTrip, IRCTC Air or directly through airline websites are also offered the option of purchasing Domestic Travel Insurance. After purchasing the policy, passengers should visit the insurance partner's portal and update their nominee details. Failure to do so may complicate the claims process. The premium generally ranges from ₹149 to ₹399 per passenger. The policy typically provides- Bus ticket bookings provide accidental cover of up to ₹7.5 lakh Passengers booking private or state-run bus tickets through platforms such as RedBus, AbhiBus and other online booking apps are also offered accident insurance. The cover is generally provided by insurers such as Acko and Tune Protect. The premium usually ranges from ₹10 to ₹25 per seat. The insurance typically includes- Government bus tickets already include accident insurance Passengers travelling on government-operated bus services, including Uttar Pradesh Roadways, are already covered by accident insurance as part of the ticket price. There is no need to pay an additional premium or tick any insurance option. The insurance premium of around ₹1 to ₹2 per passenger is already included in the fare. Under the Uttar Pradesh Roadways scheme- To make a claim, passengers or their families must submit the ticket, FIR and medical documents to the District Magistrate's office or the nearest office of the State Transport Corporation. Ola, Uber and Rapido also offer low-cost accident cover Passengers booking cabs or bike taxis through apps such as Ola, Uber and Rapido are also offered optional insurance at a nominal cost. Many users ignore the option, despite the fact that a premium of just ₹1 to ₹5 can provide accident cover of up to ₹1 lakh or more, depending on the platform. On Ola, premiums generally range from ₹1 to ₹49 depending on the type of ride. The policy provides accident cover of ₹5 lakh to ₹7.5 lakh in the event of accidental death or permanent disability. Uber offers accident insurance for approximately ₹3 per trip. The policy provides compensation of up to ₹10 lakh in the event of accidental death and up to ₹2 lakh towards hospital expenses. Rapido offers accident cover of up to ₹5 lakh for a premium ranging from 50 paise to ₹1. The policy also includes hospital expenses and, in certain cases, compensation for damages. For this reason, overlooking the insurance option while booking a journey could prove costly if an accident occurs.

stories.title: Rain alert issued for 25 UP districts:State records 44% rainfall deficit, monsoon to regain strength in two days
stories.summary: After covering the whole of Uttar Pradesh, the monsoon has weakened. As a result, only light rainfall is expected across the state over the next 48 hours, while humid conditions are likely to make the weather increasingly uncomfortable. On Sunday morning, the weather remained clear across almost all major cities, including Lucknow, Kanpur and Barabanki. Bright sunshine prevailed, although relatively cool winds provided some relief from the heat. Rain alert in 25 districts; heat and humidity warning for 26 The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rainfall alert for 25 districts on Sunday. At the same time, 26 districts have been placed under a warning for intense heat and high humidity. According to the IMD, Uttar Pradesh has received only 44 mm of rainfall between June 1 and July 4 this season. During the same period, the state normally records around 118 mm of rainfall. This means the state has received 44% less rainfall than normal so far this monsoon season. Rain recorded in 36 districts over the past 24 hours During the past 24 hours, scattered rainfall was reported in 36 districts, including Lucknow. In Mathura, two hours of rain led to waterlogging in low-lying areas. In Hathras, just 45 minutes of rainfall left roads submerged under knee-deep water, while power supply was disrupted in several localities. Light showers were also reported from Agra and Etawah. Monsoon likely to revive after two days Lucknow-based meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said the weakening of the monsoon is linked to a weather system near the northern Odisha coast. He said- The weather system that developed near the northern Odisha coast has influenced weather conditions in Uttar Pradesh. As a result, the monsoon will remain weak across the state for the next two days. Only a few districts in western and southern Uttar Pradesh are likely to receive light rainfall, while humidity and heat will increase across eastern and central parts of the state. The monsoon is expected to become active again after two days, following which rainfall will resume across the state.

stories.title: Woman digs 1.5-foot pit to bury husband:Wife dragged body to bathroom, paid ₹1,200 to make floor over it
stories.summary: 'My husband, Surendra, was addicted to alcohol. He used to beat me after drinking. I endured this for 16 years. Eventually, I decided to kill him. I crushed sleeping tablets and mixed them into his food. I woke up around 3 am and realised he was no longer breathing. I moved the children into another room and waited until morning. After sending my mother-in-law and the children away with my brother-in-law, I dug a pit in the bathroom and dragged my husband's body there. I buried it in the pit. To cover the area, I ordered soil worth ₹400, levelled the ground myself, and, the following day, hired labourers to lay a cement floor over it. They had no idea there was a body buried underneath'. This is the statement given by Ruby, who has been arrested for allegedly murdering her husband in Agra. Here is how, according to the police, she planned the killing and concealed the body beneath the bathroom floor. Read how the wife killed her husband and buried him in the bathroom Surendra Kumar Sharma (44), originally from Bharatpur in Rajasthan, lived in Renuka Dham Colony, Dahtora, in Sikandra, Agra. He married Ruby, a native of Etawah, in 2010. The couple had two daughters, Riddhi (13) and Siddhi (9). Surendra's mother, Kamala, who has poor eyesight, also lived with them. His father, Radheshyam Sharma, a retired teacher, had died a few years ago. Surendra had been missing since May 18. On May 26, Ruby lodged a missing person's report at the local police station and repeatedly told relatives and neighbours that her husband had disappeared. On Friday (July 3), police visited the house after receiving information from Surendra's brother. Officers reportedly found Ruby's behaviour suspicious. During a search of the property, they became suspicious of the bathroom floor. After excavating it, they recovered Surendra's skeletal remains. Ruby's confession to police Following her arrest, Ruby allegedly told police- ‘My marriage took place in 2010. I am from Etawah and we have two daughters, Riddhi and Siddhi. My marriage itself was built on lies. Before the wedding, I was told Surendra was educated and had a good job. After marriage, I discovered he did not work at all. I accepted it as my fate. But he was addicted to alcohol and regularly assaulted me after drinking. Even after our daughters were born, I continued to endure the abuse.’ Argument in Bharatpur before the murder Ruby told police that two days before the alleged murder, on May 16, Surendra visited relatives in Bharatpur. 'There, we had another argument. My relatives advised me to file a police complaint. On May 17, Surendra sent me back to Bharatpur to persuade them, but I was treated badly there as well. I was threatened that I, along with my husband and children, would be sent to prison. That deeply hurt me. I had built up a great deal of anger because of my husband's behaviour.' Sleeping tablets mixed in food; body buried in a 1.5-foot pit Ruby said both her husband and mother-in-law regularly took sleeping tablets. 'I crushed sleeping tablets and mixed them into my husband's food. After dinner, my husband and the children fell asleep in the same room. Around 3 am, I woke up and realised my husband had stopped breathing. I moved the children into another room and locked the room where my husband's body was lying. Since he usually woke up late, nobody became suspicious'. She further said, 'The next morning, I called my brother-in-law and sent my mother-in-law and the children away with him. Once everyone had left, I locked the house, dug a pit about one-and-a-half feet deep in the bathroom and dragged my husband's body there before burying it.' Soil ordered for ₹400 to conceal the grave Ruby further stated- 'I ordered soil worth ₹400 from a contractor to fill the bathroom. The soil was delivered to the house. I covered my husband's body myself and levelled the surface. The following day, I hired two local labourers and paid them ₹1,200 to lay a concrete floor. I ordered two bags of cement and had the floor plastered. The labourers never knew they were building over a buried body. When asked whether she regretted killing her husband, Ruby allegedly told investigators- 'I had endured 16 years of abuse. When my children were threatened with prison because of my husband's actions, I reached my breaking point. After his death, I cried. Whenever my daughters asked where their father had gone, I lied to them. Every time I entered the bathroom, I remembered that night. But I kept lying because I believed I was protecting my children's future.' Truth revealed to brother-in-law after 45 days According to police, Ruby initially tried to mislead everyone. She told her mother-in-law and brother-in-law, Anil Sharma, that Surendra had left home after an argument. She also filed a missing person's complaint and publicly mourned her husband in front of neighbours. However, Anil Sharma became suspicious. Their late father's pension of ₹64,000 was credited to a bank account operated through an ATM card that remained with Surendra. Continued transactions from the account after Surendra's disappearance raised doubts. On Friday (July 3), Anil told Ruby, 'Crying will not solve anything. If something has happened, tell me. If you are in trouble, I will help you. I will not let any harm come to you.’ Police said Ruby then broke down and confessed that she had buried her husband's body beneath the bathroom floor. Labourers broke the floor in 20 minutes Police were informed at around 12 noon on Friday. Officers reached the house and called five labourers, who broke the bathroom floor within 20 minutes before excavating the area. By then, the body had decomposed completely, leaving only skeletal remains. Sent to judicial custody for 14 days Ruby was produced before a court on Saturday (July 4) at around 5pm. The court remanded her to 14 days' judicial custody. DCP City Syed Ali Abbas said: During questioning so far, the accused has claimed she carried out the crime alone. However, based on the call detail records (CDR), police are questioning several other people as part of the investigation.

stories.title: Champat Rai not to lead Ram Mandir Trust meeting:Decision on his resignation to be made on July 6; discussion likely on 5 points
stories.summary: The meeting of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, scheduled for July 6, will be led by Treasurer Govind Dev Giri. The meeting will be held at Maniram Das Chhawani under the chairmanship of Trust President Mahant Nritya Gopal Das. General Secretary Champat Rai and Trustee Dr Anil Mishra have also been invited to attend. During the meeting, trustees will decide by majority vote whether to accept or reject the resignations submitted by Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra. Champat Rai previously handled all Trust meetings Since the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust was constituted on February 5, 2020, every Trust meeting has been conducted by General Secretary Champat Rai. He was responsible for issuing official notices, setting the agenda and presenting all key information. Champat Rai, who stepped down on June 26 following allegations relating to the theft of offerings from the Shri Ram Mandir, submitted his resignation along with Trustee Dr Anil Mishra. Treasurer Govind Dev Giri confirmed that both resignations had been received. In view of the situation, the Trust convened a meeting for July 6. Treasurer Govind Dev Giri's role has expanded Following Champat Rai's resignation, Treasurer Govind Dev Giri has assumed a larger administrative role. He issued the official notice convening the July 6 meeting and circulated it to all trustees. The meeting will begin at 3 pm at Maniram Das Chhawani, where five key agenda items will be discussed- Rules for appointing or removing Trust members The procedures for appointing or removing members of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust are governed by the Trust Deed, the Trust Bylaws and the Indian Trusts Act, 1882. The Trust may have a maximum of 15 members, comprising three ex officio members and 12 lifetime trustees. One lifetime trustee, Vimalendra Mohan Pratap Mishra, passed away in August 2025, leaving one position vacant. The resignations of Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra have created two additional vacancies, subject to the Trust's decision. Two-thirds majority required to remove a trustee A trustee may be removed if they act against the interests of the Trust, but only through a two-thirds majority vote. Before any such decision, the trustee must be served with a show-cause notice and allowed to present their case before the Trust members. The Trust Deed also lays down rules for resignations. A trustee must submit at least one month's written notice. A resignation does not automatically take effect upon submission; it must be placed before the Trust at its next meeting, where members may either accept or reject it. Accordingly, the resignations of Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra will be considered during the July 6 meeting. The remaining 12 trustees will collectively decide the matter. A two-thirds majority requires the support of at least eight members. Appointment of new trustees rests with the Trust Board The Trust Deed also specifies the procedure for appointing new trustees. The decision rests with the Trust Board and is not confined to members nominated by the Central or State governments. The only mandatory qualification is that the permanent or nominated member must be a Hindu. Under the Trust Deed and Sections 73 and 74 of the Indian Trusts Act, a new trustee can be appointed only with the approval of a two-thirds majority of the Board. Who can convene a Trust meeting? The Trust Deed ordinarily authorises the General Secretary to convene Trust meetings. However, it also allows another responsible office-bearer to perform this role in exceptional circumstances. Following Champat Rai's resignation, this responsibility has been assigned to Treasurer Govind Dev Giri. The Board also has the authority to amend the Trust Deed, provided that any amendments remain consistent with the basic framework laid down by the Supreme Court's 2019 judgment and applicable laws. Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra were invited despite resignations Although Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra have submitted their resignations, they will continue to be regarded as trustees until those resignations are formally accepted. For this reason, both have been invited to attend the July 6 meeting. Trust President Mahant Nritya Gopal Das has returned to Ayodhya after receiving medical treatment in Lucknow and is reported to be in better health. The meeting will be held at his residence in Maniram Das Chhawani, where he will preside. Founding Trust member K. Parasaran is unlikely to travel to Ayodhya due to ill health. He is expected to participate virtually. Any other trustees unable to attend in person will also have the option of joining the meeting online.

stories.title: Minister Rajbhar targets Akhilesh Yadav:'He divorced us'; says SP and Congress have lost relevance
stories.summary: In Ballia, Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar said that Akhilesh Yadav has divorced him. That's why whenever he faces him, he gets angry. Rajbhar claimed that both the SP and Congress parties are duds. Rajbhar was speaking at BJP's Jan Samvad program on Saturday evening at 6:30 pm. He said that in 2017, SP won 47 seats. But in the 2027 assembly elections, winning even 27 seats would be a big achievement for them. The program was organised at Bhikha Bhagat Pokhra complex. Power can be inherited, not wisdom Om Prakash Rajbhar said that he has prepared many wrestlers in politics. Comparing himself to the mythological character Bali, he said- Just as half the strength of opponents would vanish when Bali appeared before them, similarly, seeing him gives opponents a 100-degree fever. Power can be inherited, but not wisdom. SP leaders oppose BJP during the day, while at night they meet Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He also has photos related to this. Rajbhar also mentioned the letter written by Ramgopal Yadav to Home Minister Amit Shah during this time. Overconfidence about political future Referring to the Women's Reservation Bill, Rajbhar said that PM Modi brought a law to give 33 percent reservation to women in Lok Sabha and Vidhan Sabha. But Samajwadi Party, Congress, TMC, and Shiv Sena opposed it. Rajbhar claimed that parties opposing women's reservation have weakened. During the upcoming monsoon session, a split will also be seen in the Samajwadi Party. He said that SP should not be overconfident about its political future. Rajbhar also mentioned his political struggle. He said that when he started the campaign to bring forward the honor and history of Maharaja Suheldev on October 27, 2002, he faced strong opposition. The minister said that history and heritage are the greatest strength of any society. Without history, no society or leadership can last long. SP workers protested before Om Prakash Rajbhar's proposed public meeting in Ratsar, Phephna assembly constituency. Outside the party office on the Gadwar-Phephna road, SP workers showed black flags and raised slogans against the minister. They objected to the statement made regarding SP MP Sanatan Pandey. In view of the apprehension of protest, additional police force was deployed. Meanwhile, due to security reasons, the minister Rajbhar's travel route was also changed. Officials said that surveillance has been increased throughout the area to maintain law and order.

stories.title: Lovers jump into river holding hands:Youth texts uncle, 'I'm going to die, my bullet is parked on the bridge'
stories.summary: A couple allegedly jumped into the Ramganga River holding hands from a bridge in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, on Saturday afternoon. They had arrived at around 2:30 pm on a Bullet motorcycle, parked it by the roadside, spoke for a while and then leapt into the river together. Before jumping, the young man sent a message to his uncle saying, ‘Uncle, I am going to die. The bike is parked on the Ramganga bridge. Come with the other key.’ By the time his family reached the bridge, both had already jumped. Katghar Police, assisted by local divers, are searching for the pair, but neither has been found so far. See 3 pictures Before dying, he messaged his uncle According to the police, the youth was identified as Tushar (20), son of Nanhe. He was a resident of Suraj Nagar, Pital Basti, under the Katghar police station area. Tushar's house is about 4 km away from the incident site. Tushar's uncle, Sudhir Goswami, said that Tushar worked as a salesman at a clothing shop in Budh Bazaar in the city. As usual, he had gone from home to the shop on Saturday morning. While leaving home, Tushar had asked me for ₹100 in the morning. I had given them to him. After that, around 12 noon, he messaged me on my mobile saying that I am going to jump into Ramganga, I will take my own life. After receiving the message, family members who arrived at the scene found Tushar's Bullet motorcycle parked. Seeing the Bullet, the family members were distraught and cried inconsolably. The police have taken the Bullet into custody. Left the shop by lying After the incident, the police also gathered information about the events from the cloth shop owner. The shop owner said - Tushar had taken leave from the shop at 12 PM. He had said that he had some very urgent work at home, which is why he was going home. But after leaving the shop, he did not go home. Man was troubled by family restrictions It is being reported that Tushar had an affair with a minor girl from the neighborhood. The girl is also missing from her home. It is being said that both, troubled by family restrictions, jumped into the river with the intention of suicide. However, neither the family nor the police have confirmed this yet. It is believed to be the same girl who jumped into the river with Tushar. Currently, the police are investigating this. The police and a team of divers are engaged in the search for both. Diver Mohammad Wasim said- We received information from the police that a young man had jumped into the river from the bypass bridge. When we arrived here, we found that both the young man and the young woman had jumped into the Ramganga. Our team searched extensively. Many divers also went swimming to search, but the river has a lot of water and is deep. The water level is also rising rapidly. Therefore, there is no trace of either of them yet. Our diving team from the police, PRV, and Jama Masjid is engaged in the search. The boy's age is being told as 20 to 22 years. His family members are also present at the spot. Blood was also found near the bike SP City Ranvijay Singh, who arrived at the spot, said, On Saturday, a young man and a young woman jumped from the Ramganga bridge. Police teams are continuously engaged in their search with the help of local divers and the flood unit. A Bullet bike was found parked on the same bridge from where both of them jumped. It belongs to a boy named Tushar. Blood was also found near the bike and on the edge of the bridge. Currently, the police's first priority is to rescue both of them. Our teams are continuously working on this.

stories.title: BJP to sideline inactive booth presidents:Workers to verify SIR voter lists door-to-door; Pankaj Chaudhary says polls will be held on time
stories.summary: The BJP has stepped up preparations for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections by launching an intensive door-to-door voter list verification campaign. Party workers will visit households with the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision (SIR) list to verify voter details and ensure that every citizen aligned with the party's ideology is included on the electoral roll. The party is also identifying booth presidents who have been negligent in their duties. The decision was taken at a meeting chaired by Uttar Pradesh BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary at the party's state headquarters in Lucknow on Saturday. General Secretary's Mantra - 'If the voter list work improves, we've climbed the first step to victory' In the meeting, General Secretary (Organisation) Dharampal Singh presented the election roadmap and said, If we successfully complete the verification of the voter list and the work of adding new names, then understand that we have climbed the first step of the assembly elections. He gave several guidelines to strengthen the organisation Non-active booth presidents will be removed: Verification of presidents will be done at each booth. New faces will get a chance in place of booth presidents who are not active. After this, their conferences will be held at the district level. Leaders to stay for 7 to 10 days: State office bearers will no longer be allowed to rest. They will have to stay in districts for 7 to 10 days every month. Similarly, district presidents will camp in mandals and mandal teams will camp at booths. In the meeting, State President Pankaj Chaudhary said, There will be no premature elections in Uttar Pradesh. There are still about eight months left for the assembly elections, so everyone should get fully prepared. 'Workers should counter opposition's lies with facts' Advising the workers, the State President said, The opposition is constantly trying to create an atmosphere of lies, confusion, and misinformation. In such a situation, it is the responsibility of BJP workers to go among the public and on social media and counter this narrative of the opposition based on facts. stories.title: UP Congress in-charge alleges poor-quality milk served on Vande Bharat:Says fare is premium but milk is 'chemical-like', complains to Rail Minister
stories.summary: The Vande Bharat Express' premium service has come under scrutiny after Uttar Pradesh Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam alleged that poor-quality milk was served during his journey on Train No. 22470 from Hazrat Nizamuddin in Delhi to Jhansi on Saturday. Gautam shared videos of the milk on social media, claiming its quality was substandard. The Uttar Pradesh Congress also posted the videos, saying, 'The fare is premium, but the milk is chemical-like.' Former Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee president Brijlal Khabri was travelling with Gautam at the time. Made video himself, complained to Railway Minister and IRCTC Rajendra Pal Gautam and Brijlal Khabri were traveling with two other people on Saturday by Vande Bharat Express (22470). The four leaders were in coach E2 (seat numbers 1, 2, 3, 4) of the train. They were given milk on the train. Seeing the poor quality of the milk, Rajendra Pal Gautam himself made a video of it. Then, to expose this mischief with the health of passengers, he posted it on social media. In addition, he lodged a written complaint about this serious matter by tagging the Railway Minister and IRCTC on social media through PNR number 2955075897. Congress leader said - Why is the government so kind to vendors? Congress leaders have raised serious questions about the functioning of the railways. They said that such milk is being served to VIPs like the UP Congress in-charge on expensive trains like Vande Bharat. This clearly shows what must be happening to common passengers? The condition of passengers traveling in ordinary trains must be even worse than this. They asked why the Indian Railways and the central government, which empty the pockets of the public in the name of fare, are so kind to these vendors? Demand for high-level investigation and strict action Congress demanded a high-level investigation into the entire matter and lab testing of the milk sample. The party says that serving such 'chemical' to passengers in the name of Vande Bharat is extremely shameful. Strict legal action should be taken against the responsible vendor and company. Leaders gone to attend Congress's worker dialogue program Actually, UP Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam is touring the entire state. In this sequence, he reached Jhansi on Saturday. Here too, there was a Congress worker interaction program. Office bearers and workers of the city and district Congress committee participated in it. His effort is that in the next 3 months, the district organisation, from booth level to district level, should become fully active in every district. Along with this, he is also busy preparing the Congress's election manifesto by discussing with common people. He claims that Congress will resolve the seat-sharing issue by September. After this, the candidate selection process will begin. UP Congress in-charge on tour till 14 July Rajendra Pal will stay in Jhansi tonight. On 12 July, he will meet BIDA-affected farmers in Babina. After this, he will go to Mahoba. There, he will interact with Congress leaders from Hamirpur and Mahoba. Then in the evening, he will reach Banda. He will rest for the night in Chitrakoot. On 13 July, he will interact with officials from Chitrakoot, then Prayagraj, Kaushambi, and Fatehpur districts. In Prayagraj, he will hold a meeting with lawyers through the 'Coffee with Barrister' program. On 14 July, he will participate in the 'Students' Echo' program. Then he will come to Pratapgarh and from there to Lucknow.

stories.title: UP's first non-government AI lab opens in Varanasi:Students to receive advanced technical education
stories.summary: A state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Robotics Lab was inaugurated at 4 pm on Saturday at PM Shri Rajkiya Queens Inter College in Varanasi. Organisers said it is the first AI and Robotics lab to be set up in a government school in Uttar Pradesh without any government financial assistance, aiming to equip students with practical skills in emerging technologies. The lab was developed under the guidance of former principal Sumeet Kumar Srivastava and the Queens College Alumni Association, led by Prof. Dharmendra Singh, Director of IIIT Vadodara, with support from PHN Technology. Although the facility was completed around six months ago, it was formally inaugurated on Saturday. Speaking at the event, Prof. Singh said the lab would help students build expertise in AI and robotics while encouraging innovation, start-ups and entrepreneurship. Students to get state-of-the-art facilities in the lab Pradeep H. Narayankar, representative of PHN Technology, said that their organization has been working for a long time to promote technical education. He informed that this lab has been equipped with state-of-the-art resources and modern equipment, and its quality is equivalent to that of any IIT laboratory. According to him, new opportunities for employment and self-employment will open up for students receiving training here. Provision to also be made for trained instructors Prof. Pradeep Kumar Mishra, President of Queen's College Alumni Association, called it a historic day in the history of the school and said that this lab will provide a new direction to the technical future of the students. He informed that trained instructors will also be arranged for the effective operation of the lab, so that students can receive regular and quality training. Professor Manoj Srivastava of BHU also participated in the program.

stories.title: Youth in Gorakhpur to receive folk music training:Free 10-day workshop begins on 12 July; registration free
stories.summary: A 10-day workshop on traditional folk songs will be organised by Sharda Sangeetalaya of Gorakhpur in collaboration with the Culture Department, Uttar Pradesh. It will start on 12 July at 4 pm and will continue till 21 July. This event will be held at S.S. Academy, located opposite AD Mall. During this, the new generation will be given practical training in many traditional folk songs like Kajri, Sohar, wedding songs, Jhumar, Chaita, Nirgun. Registration for participants will be free. People of all ages can participate. Folk songs are the cultural identity of folk life - Dr. Rakesh Dr. Rakesh Srivastava, the workshop trainer and folk singer, said that folk songs are the cultural identity of Indian folk life. This workshop is being organised with the aim of preserving, promoting them, and connecting the new generation with their folk traditions. He informed that practical training of various traditional folk songs, including Kajri, Sohar, wedding songs, Jhumar, Chaita, Nirgun will be given in the workshop. Men and women of all age groups can participate in it for free. Interested people can get their free registration done by attending the workshop venue on 12 July at 4 pm. Dr. Srivastava has appealed to the music lovers and youth of the district to participate in large numbers and make this cultural campaign a success.

stories.title: Case registered against doctor couple over fake trust deed:Court orders FIR for opening RBL Bank accounts
stories.summary: Malay Mohan, Branch Manager of RBL Bank's Indiranagar branch in Lucknow, has accused a doctor couple of opening bank accounts through a fake trust deed, irregularities in financial transactions, and threatening to kill him. The manager complained to the police, but when no action was taken, he sought help from the court. Following this, a case was registered on the court's order. Branch Manager Mayal Mohan stated in his complaint to the police that in 2022, accounts were opened in the Indiranagar branch of RBL Bank in the names of Hind Charitable Trust's institutions, Hind Institute of Medical Sciences, Safedabad (Barabanki), and Hind Institute of Medical Sciences, Ataria (Sitapur). While opening the accounts, Dr. Amod Kumar Sachan and his wife, Richa Mishra, submitted the trust deed and other KYC documents, identifying themselves as authorized representatives of the trust. Claim of trust deed being fake in investigation The bank manager alleges that after receiving information about the embezzlement case registered at Kaiserbagh police station in March 2026, the police instructed to stop the operation of the trust's accounts. Following this, the bank made all accounts 'no-debit'. Later, when the original deed of the trust was verified, it was found that the trust deed submitted to the bank was forged. The original trust deed had seven trustees, whereas the document submitted to the bank showed only Dr. Amod Kumar Sachan and Richa Mishra as trustees. Allegation of death threat over phone Malay Mohan states that Dr. Amod Kumar Sachan, angered by the freezing of accounts, called on the night of March 17 and pressured him to immediately reactivate the accounts. When the bank expressed its inability, he used abusive language and threatened to kill him and his family, not let him live in Lucknow, and prevent him from working. The bank manager also has a recording of the conversation as evidence. Allegation of police inaction Malay Mohan says that he sent a written complaint to Ghazipur police station and later to the Police Commissioner, but no FIR was registered. After this, he filed a petition in court demanding registration of a case against Dr. Amod Kumar Sachan and Richa Mishra under relevant sections including fraud, forgery, and intimidation. On whose order, the case was registered. Information about scam up to 94 crores Manvendra Singh, son of Hind Institute of Medical Sciences Founder Trustee Brij Kishore Singh, said that when they came to know that there was some irregularity in the bank accounts. On investigating at the bank, it was found that a fake deed was prepared by forging their original deed. In which only Dr. Amod Kumar Sachan and Richa Mishra are present, and through them, all bank operations are being conducted. In this way, a lot of college money has been spent on irrelevant and personal things. The police have informed the court in writing that fraud up to 94 crores has been detected. But this case could be worth more than 600 crores. No contact has been made since the fraud. They just claim that the college is theirs. Kaiserbagh police have collected all the evidence. Now it is unknown why there is a delay in action. Regarding the matter, the Station House Officer of Ghazipur says that a case has been registered. Action will be taken based on the evidence.

stories.title: Tourism department launches new Kashi package for visitors:Tourists can explore temples with a guide for ₹2,200
stories.summary: For devotees and tourists visiting Kashi, the Uttar Pradesh Tourism Department has launched special Heritage Walk packages with the aim of offering a tour of the city's major religious and cultural sites in a short time and at an affordable cost. Through these packages, tourists will be able to experience the Kashi Vishwanath Temple, prominent ghats, ancient temples, Ganga Aarti, and Banarasi cuisine in approximately five hours. Tourism department launches website Dinesh Kumar, Joint Director of the Tourism Department, stated, The objective of these packages is to introduce tourists visiting for a short duration to the spiritual, cultural, and historical heritage of Kashi. The packages are being promoted at various locations, including Cantt Railway Station, Airport, Ganga Ghats, and Kashi Vishwanath Dham. Interested tourists can book online by visiting the department's website www.darshan-kashi-gov.in or by scanning the designated QR code. Tourism department has released 3 packages The Tourism Department has prepared three special packages. The Divya Kashi Heritage Walk is priced at 2,200 rupees per person. It includes Mangala Aarti, darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, visits to several major religious sites including Maa Annapurna, Vishalakshi, Pashupatinath, Manikarnika Ghat, Rudraksha mala, prasad, guide, and refreshments. The second Assi Kashi Heritage Walk package is ₹2,500 per person. It will include 'Subah-e-Banaras' at Assi Ghat with Mangala Aarti, travel by boat or e-bus, darshan at major temples, a taste of Banarasi tea and kachori, and guide facilities. The third is the Old Kashi Heritage Walk evening package, priced at ₹2,499 per person. It includes facilities such as Man Mandir Observatory, prominent temples, Ganga Aarti at Lalita Ghat, VIP darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Banarasi Chaat experience, and a guide and prasad.

stories.title: 7-year-old girl gang-raped and murdered:Abducted while playing outside home; semi-naked body found in mall; FIR against 3
stories.summary: A 7-year-old girl was gang-raped and then murdered in Ghaziabad on Friday. Around 1 am, her body was found semi-naked and covered in blood in the basement of an under-construction mall. The girl's head was crushed, and there were also injury marks on her throat. According to family members, the girl was playing outside her home around 7 pm. After this, she suddenly went missing. Despite extensive searching, when she couldn't be found, the police were informed late at night. Police scanned the footage from nearby CCTV cameras, in which three youths were seen taking the girl towards the basement of the under-construction building. Police searched the basement, where the girl's body was recovered. She was unclothed. The incident occurred in the Nandgram police station area, 7 kilometers away from the district headquarters. Police have registered a case of gang-rape and kidnapping against three accused. Police have taken two people into custody and are interrogating them. Complete details According to the police, on Friday night around 10 pm, the child's family reached Nandgram police station. They stated that they are residents of Bihar and work as laborers in the under-construction mall. Their family lives within the mall premises. The family told the police that around 7 pm, their daughter was playing outside the house. After that, she suddenly disappeared. Despite extensive searching, she could not be found, after which the police were informed. Around 1 am late at night, information was received on Dial-112 about a body found in the basement. Clue found from CCTV footage According to the family, the police searched the CCTV footage from cameras installed around the mall. In one camera, three youths were seen taking the girl towards the basement. After this, the basement was searched, where the girl's body was found. The family says that the girl's body had no clothes on. Her head was crushed, there were scratch marks on her throat, and blood was flowing from her body. After this, they filed a complaint against three accused, on which the police registered a case. Mother said - When daughter's body was found, she had no clothes on The girl's mother said, My daughter was 7 years old. She was missing since Friday evening. Her body was found at night. When the body was found, she had no clothes on. Three people did wrong to her. DCP inspected the crime scene As soon as information about the incident was received, senior officials were informed. A short while later, DCP City Dhaval Jaiswal reached the spot along with officials. Forensic and dog squad teams were also called. Officials took information about the incident from the family members and inspected the crime scene. Accused said - Raped under the influence of intoxication On the instructions of the DCP, the police started searching for the accused. At night, two accused were taken into custody some distance from the mall. While one of their accomplices is absconding. During interrogation, the accused told that all three of them are laborers and work in another nearby building. They had sat together and consumed alcohol. After that, they took the girl to the basement and raped her. Police said - Accused confessed to the crime DCP City Dhaval Jaiswal stated, The gangrape of the girl has been confirmed. Based on the complaint of the family, an FIR has been registered against three accused. Of these, two accused have been taken into custody, while the search for the third is ongoing. According to the police, the accused have confessed to their crime during interrogation. Further interrogation is currently underway.

stories.title: Temple crumbles down during bulldozer demolition, 1 killed:Structure built in middle of road, was being removed for widening
stories.summary: A labourer was killed and another injured, after the dome of the 200-year-old Kali Mata Temple suddenly collapsed during a bulldozer demolition in Chandauli, Uttar Pradesh, on Friday night. The accident occurred at around 11 pm in Mughalsarai, while the temple, located in the middle of the road, was being demolished as part of the Mughalsarai–Varanasi road-widening project. Both labourers were standing about 10 feet away holding a rope when the dome collapsed so quickly that they were unable to escape and were buried under the debris. Locals pulled them out after removing the rubble, but 58-year-old Baldev Yadav died, while the other labourer was injured. A video of the incident has also surfaced, and officials halted the demolition work after reaching the site. See 3 pictures- Find out what's visible in the video The video shows Baldev Yadav and another laborer standing, holding a rope, while the bulldozer demolishes the temple. Suddenly, the temple begins to collapse. After the temple's dome collides with the bulldozer, it changes direction and turns towards both labourers. Both try to run, but the dome breaks through the barricading and falls on them. People and policemen present nearby pulled both of them out and took them to the CHC. There, doctors declared Baldev dead, while the other labourer is undergoing treatment. Brother said - Family should get 50 lakh compensation Nathni Yadav, a resident of Jhumri, alleged that he was informed about the incident approximately an hour after his brother Baldev's death. When he reached the spot, no one told him the correct information. After much inquiry, a policeman handed over his brother's mobile phone. He demanded that the family be given a compensation of 50 lakh and Baldev's son be given a job. SDM said - will provide all possible help to the family SDM Rajiv Mohan Saxena said, All possible help would be provided to the family. Currently, the matter is being investigated. The road widening work was awarded to a private company. Baldev had been working for the same company for the last 3 years. The company will also help the family.

stories.title: Yogi asks crowd who wants to act with Ravi Kishan:Attacks oppn, says, 'Those raising questions did nothing when they had power'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath took a light-hearted dig at Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan during a public meeting in Kushinagar at around 11:30 am on Friday. Asking the crowd how many had watched Ravi Kishan's films and who wanted to act alongside him, the Chief Minister smiled and said, First, work with MP Vijay Dubey. Then you will also get a chance to work with Ravi Kishan. Attacking the opposition, he said, Today, those who question us about development, I want to ask them, what did they do when they were in power? Those who themselves could do nothing, are today making accusations. Before 2017, the state had neither the intention nor a clear policy, which is why development works remained stalled. The Chief Minister inaugurated and laid the foundation stone for development projects worth approximately ₹525 crore for the Ramkola, Hata, and Kushinagar tehsils of the district. The CM also honored elderly BJP workers, 110-year-old Ramvilas Bhagat and 104-year-old Rampravesh Sahni. Main points of CM Yogi's speech 1. Samajwadi goons used to grab the jobs and land of the poor The Chief Minister said that before 2017, obstacles were created even in the organisation of festivals like Durga Puja, Janmashtami, and Holi. Samajwadi goons used to grab the jobs and land of the poor, but the double-engine government does not tolerate hooliganism at all. Now, if anyone tries to spoil the atmosphere or create mischief during festivals, strict action is taken against them. Now, no curfew, no riots, everything is fine in UP. 2. Earlier boundary walls of cemeteries were built, now renovation of temples Yogi said that when governments themselves are victims of policy paralysis, how will policies be made? This was the situation in the state before 2017. Referring to the renovation of temples, he said that today temples are being renovated in every assembly constituency. Earlier, boundary walls of cemeteries were built with the money received in the name of temples. But now that doesn't happen. 3. Targeting previous governments while mentioning encephalitis Yogi said that it used to be this season when a large number of children died due to Japanese encephalitis. The governments of that time were insensitive and did not even make adequate arrangements for the treatment of children. Today, we have eradicated encephalitis from its roots. When I see a smile on the faces of these children, I feel that life has become meaningful. 4. Musahar community received respect Yogi said that those who did politics in the name of the poor and deprived sections for years did not give the Musahar community their rights. Today, there is a smile on the faces of the Musahar community, and they have realized that they too are respected citizens of this country. This change has been possible due to the schemes of the double-engine government. 5. Airport operations will commence upon receipt of new aircraft CM Yogi said that due to the Corona pandemic and global war, new aircraft could not be made available on time. Because of this, the operation of Kushinagar Airport could not start at the expected pace. As soon as new aircraft are available, Kushinagar Airport will be developed as a model international airport and will also be connected to Jewar and Ayodhya airports. 6. CM asked - Will you act with Ravi Kishan? The Chief Minister took a dig at Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan, who was present at the event. He said, ‘I welcome Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan ji, who has come at the invitation of Kushinagar MP Vijay Dubey.’ After that, smiling, he asked the public, 'How many people have seen Ravi Kishan's film? Who wants to work with him in a film?' Then he said, ‘First work with our MP Vijay Dubey, after that, you will get a chance with Ravi Kishan too.’ The Chief Minister's remark drew laughter from the public gathering. Ravi Kishan said that Maharaj ji called me, the MP did not bring me Earlier, BJP MP Ravi Kishan, in his Bhojpuri style, said, Clap loudly in Maharaj ji's welcome. This is my first time in Tekuatar. Maharaj ji has brought me here. If the MP says he brought me, he is wrong. Maharaj ji brought me, the MP did not call me. At his words, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and everyone present on the stage were seen smiling and laughing.

stories.title: Akhilesh meets Lalita murder victim's family:Iqra brings them from Meerut; SP chief says, 'Those meant to deliver justice are slapping people'
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav met the family of the Meerut Lalita murder case victim at 8:30 am on Saturday. He spoke with Lalita’s family behind closed doors for 1 hour and 15 minutes at his official residence in Delhi. He also handed over a cheque of 2 lakh rupees to them. According to sources, Akhilesh called the family on Friday night, inviting them to Delhi for a meeting. Kairana MP Iqra Hasan reached Delhi with her parents and brother. The grieving family narrated the entire incident to Akhilesh. Akhilesh assured Lalita’s father, saying, The daughter will get justice. Once our government is formed, we will provide a job to one member of the family. He also took a swipe at Meerut SSP Avinash Pandey, stating, The very police officers from whom justice is expected are slapping the public out of injustice and arrogance. The video is tarnishing the image of the UP Police. Sensitive police officers are feeling ashamed because of this before the general public. In fact, the body of Lalita Gautam, a BA student, was found in a sugarcane field on 17 May. Alleging gang-rape and murder, the family members had staged a protest outside the Collectorate. Upon receiving information, SSP Avinash Pandey arrived at the spot. It is alleged that he slapped the protesting individuals. The police then launched a baton charge to disperse the protesters from the area. Akhilesh to raise the matter in assembly According to sources, Akhilesh told the family, The accused Ankush's brother, Ankit, who is in the PAC (Pradeshik Armed Constabulary), has been suspended; we will ensure a case is registered against him too and get him arrested. We will also ensure justice for those who were demanding justice for Lalita Gautam at the Collectorate gate, upon whom the police rained batons, sticks, and slaps. We will make every effort to get the cases dropped against the 13 people who were booked by the police simply for demanding justice. We will raise this entire matter in the House. 'Atrocity of a massive scale' committed against 'Meerut’s daughter' Earlier, Akhilesh wrote on ‘X’, When the one holding the reins is himself unbridled, then what can one expect from the gatekeepers of his court? An atrocity of a massive scale has been committed against 'Meerut’s daughter'. Named accused were booked under weak sections of the law, whereas serious sections were slapped against the protesters.This is the pinnacle of injustice. The PDA (Pichhda, Dalit, Alpasankhyak) will no longer tolerate this, they will speak up. The truth is, in a state where the chief himself publicly displays indecent behaviour towards women, particularly towards the grieving mother of a young deceased, it is futile to expect anything from his police. The fingers only follow the commands of the brain. Victim's family terrified by Meerut SSP’s attitude Iqra Hasan told Dainik Bhaskar that the victim's family has been terrified since the Meerut SSP’s outburst. She said, Today, we met the SP National President Akhilesh Yadav. The SSP used casteist slurs against the grieving family. The heights of arrogance were crossed. This is the first time an IPS officer has indulged in such hooliganism. Immediate action must be taken against such officers. Sangeet Som meets Lalita Gautam’s family Former MLA Sangeet Som visited Lalita Gautam's family and assured them of all possible assistance. He said, "The daughter will get justice at all costs." He also announced financial assistance to cover the lawyer's fees. He added, 'Wrong has been done to the daughter, so she must get justice.' He reassured the family that the entire state government stands with them, and every possible action will be taken to ensure the harshest punishment for the culprits. The government will strongly plead the case under legal procedures to ensure the accused face the gallows. The victim's family should not face any hindrance in fighting a strong legal battle. To ensure this, he announced financial aid from his end for the lawyer's fees, enabling the family to pursue the case through a competent advocate. Right-wing leader Pinky Chaudhary placed under house arrest The National President of Hindu Raksha Dal, Pinky Chaudhary, who was on his way to meet Lalita Gautam’s family in Meerut, was placed under house arrest by the police at his residence in Ghaziabad. MP Chandrashekhar met family yesterday Prior to this, on 10 July, MP Chandrashekhar Azad met Lalita's family in Meerut. Giving a 7-day ultimatum to the administration, the MP stated, ‘If justice is not delivered, we will launch a protest in Lucknow and raise the matter in the Lok Sabha as well.’ Key facts about student Lalita Gautam murder case 'My supporters should plant one sapling, opponents should plant two' Meanwhile, SSP Avinash Pandey released a video on 10 July, stating, Whatever action has been taken, it has been taken against criminals. We have evidence for everything. Those making personal comments about me will be counselled. I will try to make them understand. However, those trying to disrupt law and order will not be forgiven at all. He concluded with an appeal. He said, I would like to appeal to those who support me to plant a tree during the upcoming plantation festival and avoid littering polythene around them. I would also like to appeal to those who oppose me to plant two trees. Channel your anger for the good of society, rather than speaking about a specific caste or supporting criminals who disrupt law and order.

stories.title: Fighter jets soar over Kashi skies:Pilots on Rafale and Surya Kiran team conduct rehearsals ahead of Air Force Day
stories.summary: On Saturday morning at 10 AM in Varanasi, Indian Air Force fighter jets soared in the skies of Kashi. This included Rafale and Surya Kiran. People in the city were surprised by the high-speed flight of three fighter jets simultaneously. From morning, fighter jets continuously circled over Namo Ghat and the city, taking off from different directions. This happened as part of the rehearsal for the proposed air show at Namo Ghat on the occasion of Air Force Day. Crowds gathered at Namo Ghat to watch the fighter jets fly. See 2 pictures The exercise lasted for two and a half hours. The Air Force's 94th Foundation Day is on October 8. This time, the event will be held in Kashi. As part of this, Rafale and Surya Kiran fighter jets flew here on Saturday. Hearing the loud sound echoing in the sky, people came out of their homes, roofs, balconies, and onto the streets. Many people recorded this scene on their mobile phones and shared it on social media. This activity, which started in the morning, continued till approximately 12:30 PM. During this, fighter jets flew in different formations, circling over Namo Ghat multiple times. Their loud roar could be heard far and wide, filling the entire city with excitement. Tremendous enthusiasm among people Rahul, a devotee present at Ganga Ghat, said, “The simultaneous flight of three fighter jets and their high speed greatly attracted people. People present at the ghat continuously engaged in taking pictures and videos of the aircraft. Many people reached Assi Ghat with their families to enjoy this spectacle. For some time, the entire ghat became a witness to this practice flight of the Air Force.” Tight security at Namo Ghat since morning Along with the flight of fighter jets, the security arrangements at Namo Ghat were strict. Indian Air Force officers and jawans were deployed in the helipad area for the morning. Due to security reasons, the movement of the public beyond Phase-2 of Namo Ghat was completely restricted. No person was allowed to go towards the helipad area and security personnel kept sending people back from the designated limit.

stories.title: Tarang Overbridge to remain closed for 18 days:PWD will replace expansion joints and bearings of the structure
stories.summary: The Tarang Overbridge, which goes from Tarang Mod to Harhawa Phatak in Gorakhpur, will remain closed for repair works from 13 July to 30 July. The Public Works Department (PWD) will replace the expansion joints and bearings of the bridge. Permission has been received from the traffic police in this regard. During the repair, the movement of all types of vehicles on the overbridge will be completely prohibited. Earlier, at the Tarang railway crossing, long traffic jams used to occur daily for hours during the movement of trains. To provide relief to people from this problem, an overbridge was constructed from Tarang Mod to Harhawa Phatak a few years ago. After the construction of the bridge, the traffic jams at the railway crossing were largely reduced, and the commute for thousands of people became easier. Need for repair came to light during inspection Recently, PWD engineers conducted a technical inspection of the bridge. During the inspection, the need to replace expansion joints and bearings came to light. Subsequently, a proposal for maintenance work was prepared to ensure the safety and strength of the bridge. Now, the work of replacing both parts will be carried out within the stipulated period. Target to complete work by July 30 U.P. Singh, Executive Engineer of PWD Construction Division-3, stated that repair work will begin on 13 July and is targeted to be completed by 30 July. He informed that people will have to use alternative routes during the work. The traffic department has also appealed to the general public for cooperation, so that the repair work can be completed on time and the city's traffic system remains smooth.

stories.title: Janata Darshan cancelled tomorrow for plantation drive:CM urges everyone to plant a tree and take responsibility for its protection
stories.summary: The regular 'Janata Darshan' (public audience) held during Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's visit to Gorakhpur will not take place on Sunday (12 July). The decision to postpone it has been taken due to the 'Plantation Mahayagya 2026'. The state has a target of planting 35 crore saplings. To achieve this, the Chief Minister will inaugurate this grand plantation drive by planting a sapling near the Gorakhpur Link Expressway on Sunday at 7:45 AM. The Shri Gorakhnath Temple office has stated that the Janata Darshan programme will remain postponed tomorrow to ensure maximum public participation in this grand plantation drive. The Chief Minister will arrive at the Gorakhpur Link Expressway at 7:45 AM. There, he will plant a sapling near the Bhagwanpur Toll Plaza. With this, the 'Plantation Mahayagya' will commence across the entire state. After this, he will address the public meeting organised there. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has appealed to all state residents to ensure their participation in the tree plantation mega-campaign by planting at least one sapling and taking a pledge to protect it. The Chief Minister said that in line with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's call, every citizen should try to convert the resolve of environmental protection into a reality by planting 'one tree in the name of mother'. Complainants come from far and wide Upon receiving information about the Chief Minister's presence in Gorakhpur, complainants come from far and wide to Gorakhnath Temple with their problems. Usually, when the Chief Minister is present here, a 'Janata Darshan' (public audience) is organised. This is the first time that an official announcement has been issued regarding the postponement of the 'Janata Darshan' programme. The purpose behind issuing the information on time is to prevent people from coming here unnecessarily and facing inconvenience. The Chief Minister will depart for Lucknow tomorrow afternoon.

stories.title: Kali temple dome collapses during road widening work:PWD employee killed, another injured; demolition halted
stories.summary: A major accident occurred late on Friday night during the demolition of an ancient Kali temple in the Mughalsarai Kotwali area amid road widening work. During the demolition, the massive dome of the temple suddenly collapsed. A PWD employee died in the accident, while another person was seriously injured. The demolition work was underway late at night using a bulldozer for road widening. During this time, PWD employee Jhumri alias Baldev (58), a resident of Padav Dandi, was standing there holding a rope. Suddenly, the temple dome collapsed. While falling, the dome hit the bulldozer bucket, changed direction and fell on Baldev and another person, trapping them. Chaos broke out at the spot after the accident. Both injured persons were immediately taken to hospital, where Baldev died during treatment. The other injured person is undergoing treatment. After the incident, administrative officials, police personnel and local residents started relief and rescue operations. The demolition work was halted for some time as a safety measure. As soon as the information was received, Mughalsarai SDM Rajiv Mohan Saxena and Kotwali in-charge Vijay Pratap Singh reached the spot. The officials inspected the site and gathered details about the entire incident. The cause of the accident is being investigated.

stories.title: Bird hits Flydubai aircraft in Lucknow:Emergency landing carried out, 163 passengers onboard; plane stranded at airport for 6 hours
stories.summary: A Flydubai aircraft (FD-443) heading to Lucknow was hit by a bird on Saturday morning when it was approaching the city. Following the bird strike, the pilot carried out an emergency landing. The aircraft had 163 passengers onboard. The flight was scheduled to reach Lucknow at 6:35 am and was expected to arrive 40 minutes late. After the bird hit, the pilot requested an emergency slot on the runway. The aircraft landed safely at Lucknow airport at 7:13 am. Even after around six hours, the aircraft remained parked in the airport’s parking bay at 1:30 pm. Following the incident, the plane was moved from the runway to the parking bay, where a detailed technical inspection is being carried out. The aircraft was already delayed by 48 minutes from its scheduled time. The same aircraft was scheduled to depart from Lucknow for Dubai again after an hour.

stories.title: Advocate thrashes constable in Kanpur:Cop, who appeared drunk, suspended; FIR to be filed after probe
stories.summary: A video of an advocate allegedly beating a police constable near the Kanpur court went viral on social media on Friday. After receiving information about the incident, DCP East ordered an investigation. Following a preliminary probe, the constable involved in the dispute was suspended. A departmental inquiry has also been initiated. A case will be registered after the investigation report is submitted. Constable suspended ACP Line Anand Ojha said a video went viral on Friday evening showing a fight and argument between two police personnel and an advocate. During the investigation, it was found that one of the two constables seen in the video had already been suspended and had been absent for a long time. The other constable was immediately suspended on charges of indiscipline and inappropriate conduct. The preliminary investigation suggested that the constable appeared to be intoxicated. People present at the spot also claimed that the dispute occurred while the constable was under the influence of alcohol. Action was taken against the constable based on these findings. The matter is currently under investigation, and further action will be taken soon based on statements from both sides and available evidence.

stories.title: Nripendra Mishra calls Ram Mandir donation theft a stigma:SP poster says, 'Ram naam japna, chadhaya daan apna'
stories.summary: In the Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft case, Nripendra Mishra, chairman of the Ram Mandir Construction Committee, said on Saturday that the incident was “a kind of stigma”. He said that everyone involved was not only saddened by it but also felt “embarrassed”. “I have full faith that the system will be improved and such incidents will not happen again,” Mishra said. He added, “A high-level committee has been formed. A judge is likely to be its chairman. The committee will submit its decision and recommendations to the trust, which will then consider them.” Nripendra Mishra arrived at the Ram Katha Museum on Saturday to attend the second day of the Ram Temple Construction Committee meeting. Earlier, during the meeting held at the Ram Temple premises on Friday, none of the trust members had attended. Meanwhile, in Gorakhpur, Samajwadi Party leader Upendra Dutt Shukla put up posters on Friday night targeting the controversy. The posters read: “Chanting Ram’s name, claiming devotees’ donations. Lord Ram had told Sita that such an age would come, where thieves would steal from temples and the watchman would only watch.” In Raebareli, the Vishva Hindu Raksha Parishad (VHRP) national general secretary Rahul Singh hit back at the Samajwadi Party by putting up posters. The posters questioned: “Questions over donations to Ram Temple, silence over terror funding? Lord Ram is our faith, not a tool for politics.”

stories.title: Ghaziabad woman says ‘father’s intestines came out after stabbing’:'Husband used to beat me like monster'; son-in-law kills father-in-law
stories.summary: ‘I cannot explain what all my husband did to me. I kept tolerating it for years, hoping that he would change one day. But he used to drink alcohol and beat me like a cruel man. Six months ago, he broke both my ribs. This time, he came to kill me, but my father stepped in and lost his life while saving mine.’ Saying this, Monika, a resident of Modinagar in Ghaziabad, broke down in tears. Her brother standing nearby supported her and comforted her. Monika somehow composed herself. A medical representative (MR) husband killed his father-in-law in Ghaziabad on Thursday night around 10:30 pm. He stabbed his father-in-law five times in the stomach. When his wife rushed to save her father, the accused attacked her with the knife, injuring her hand. The injured wife Monika said, “Three days ago, my husband slapped me after drinking alcohol. I came to my parental home, but he came here to kill me. My father was suffering from blood cancer. He came in between to save me. That ruthless man did not spare my sick father either. He stabbed him in the stomach. My father’s intestines came out in front of my eyes.” Dainik Bhaskar spoke to Monika, who is devastated after her father’s murder. Read what the victim said… Sandeep said - 'I won't leave him alive today' Monika said, “On the night of July 9, around 10 pm, Sandeep came to my parental home in an intoxicated condition. He asked me to come with him. My father (Anar Singh) refused and said he would complain to the police. After this, Sandeep took out a knife and said, ‘I will not let you live today.’” “When Sandeep moved towards me, my father came in between. Sandeep then attacked my father repeatedly with the knife. When I tried to intervene, he slashed my hand with the knife. My thumb was cut and I received eight stitches. He also assaulted my mother and then fled.” Monica said - 'He had broken both my ribs' Monika said, “My husband had been physically abusing me after our marriage. When my son was born, he locked me inside a room and beat me. Six months ago, he broke both my ribs. Many times, I thought he would change, but his behaviour never improved.” “He assaulted me a month ago as well. After that, I came to my parental home. Two days before the incident, Sandeep was roaming around near our house and threatening me.” Monika said her father was suffering from blood cancer and was undergoing treatment. “We were praying to God for his recovery and long life, but I never imagined that my own husband would take my father’s life.” Now read the complete sequence of events... In Ghaziabad, medical representative Sandeep killed his father-in-law Anar Singh on Thursday night around 10:30 pm. He stabbed him five times in the stomach. When his wife came to intervene, he pushed her and escaped. According to police, Sandeep had slapped his wife three days earlier. Upset over this, Monika had gone to her parental home. On Thursday night, Sandeep reached his in-laws’ house to convince his wife to return with him. However, Monika refused to go with him. This angered him, and he started arguing with her. Hearing the commotion, his father-in-law Anar Singh scolded him and asked him to leave the house. Meanwhile, Sandeep took out a knife from his waist and repeatedly attacked his father-in-law. Hearing the screams, family members rushed in and took Anar Singh to hospital. He died during treatment at 8 am on Friday. Sandeep had a love marriage with Monika 19 years ago. The incident took place on Fafarana Road in Modinagar. Anar Singh (65), a resident of Modinagar’s Fafarana Road, was a retired employee of Modi Rubber Factory. He is survived by three daughters and one son. Sandeep Chaudhary, originally from Shikarpur in Bulandshahr, currently lives in the Brahmpuri area of Modinagar. Anar’s son Deepanshu told police, “My sister Monika, also known as Monu, had a love marriage with Sandeep. For the past one year, there had been disputes between my sister and brother-in-law. Sandeep used to harass her frequently. They had a dispute three days ago as well, due to which my sister came to our parental home. This angered my brother-in-law.” FIR of murder registered against brother-in-law In the murder case of Anar Singh, his only son Deepanshu Chaudhary lodged an FIR against his brother-in-law Sandeep Chaudhary at Modinagar police station. Police have detained the accused’s 18-year-old elder son. DCP Rural Surendranath Tiwari said: “Three police teams have been formed to arrest the main accused Sandeep Chaudhary. Police teams have also conducted raids in Bulandshahr in search of him.”

stories.title: IT company owner among 4 killed in Rampur road accident:Car rams into DCM while travelling to Uttarakhand; passengers trapped inside
stories.summary: On Saturday at 5 AM, a speeding Eco car crashed into a stationary DCM in Rampur, UP. In the accident, four people sitting in the car died on the spot. Three were seriously injured. All were going from Delhi to Nainital for sightseeing. According to eyewitnesses, the DCM was parked on the roadside. The Eco car coming from behind must have been traveling at a speed of around 100kmph. The collision was so severe that the front part of the car was completely smashed. Its roof flew off. The people sitting in the car kept writhing inside. A video after the accident has surfaced. In it, a blood-soaked youth trapped among the corpses is pleading with people for help. He says, ‘Brother, save me’. After great effort, the police pulled out the bodies. The injured were taken to a nearby hospital. Police say that all 7 people in the car are said to be residents of Delhi-NCR. All were between 30 and 35 years of age. All had left from Delhi for Uttarakhand to visit Jim Corbett National Park and Nainital. 3 pictures of the accident-
